resolution.zhHans: 凶手是 Yurika Suwayama。最关键的线索是她的发饰。一整天下来它都是漂亮的银色，如今却变成了黯淡的黑色！这是因为下午 1:30 到 2:30 之间，系统在北边的田里喷洒了天然农药木醋液，而酸性液体会让银氧化。她用来实施这起谋杀的手法被称为 Ebi-Sora：她把一件和服衣带系在 Kengo 的脖子上，并让他趴着把身体蜷起来。随后她把绳子的另一端绑在他的脚踝上，迫使他一直保持蜷缩的姿势，以免他自己勒住自己。最终他等不到救援、精疲力竭，还是窒息而死。证明这一点的，是 Kengo 脖子上多道绳痕——那是他试图阻止自己窒息时留下的。Yurika 这样做是为了在死亡发生的时段制造不在场证明，因为她知道他迟早会死。Yurika 供认，Kengo 打算跟她离婚，因为他说 Yurika 对葡萄酒生意一窍不通，这让她怒不可遏。她高喊 Kengo 爱葡萄酒胜过爱她，又加了一句：「葡萄才没有更重要！葡萄酒根本无足轻重！」随后崩溃痛哭。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yurika Suwayama. The biggest clue is her hair ornament. Throughout the day, it was a beautiful sliver, now it was a tarnished black! This is because between 1:30pm-2:30 the system turned on the natural pesticide, pyroligneous, in the north field and acidic fluids turns sliver oxidized. The method she used to commit this murder is known as the as Ebi-Sora, she tied a robe around Kengo's neck and had him curl up his body while on his stomach. She then tied the other end of the rope to his ankles forcing to him keep his body curled up to prevent him from choking himself. Eventually he was too tried to wait for help and ended up choking himself. The proof of this is the multiple rope marks on Kengo's neck from trying to stop himself from choking. Yurika did this to establish an alibi during his death, as she knew it was only a matter of time till he died. Yurika confessed that Kengo was going to divorce her because he said Yurika knew nothing about the wine business, which makes her furious. She yells out that Kengo loved wine more than her and adds, "GRAPES AREN'T MORE IMPORTANT! WINE IS INSIGNIFICANT!" and breaks down in tears.

summary.en:
Location: Barrel warehouse

Victim: Kengo Suwayama

Age: 33 years old

suspects: Tomoaki Mizumachi, Yurika Suwayama, Akihiro Yamaguchi, and Shuuji Takashina
